title: paths-filter action exists in two mirrored copies and tests read ci-frontend.yml filters
answers: Where are paths-filter tests for the frontend_code filter?
Do I need to edit both .depot and .github paths-filter action tests?
How to test a change to ci-frontend.yml path filters?
body:
`.depot/actions/paths-filter/__tests__/filter.test.ts` and `.github/actions/paths-filter/__tests__/filter.test.ts` are identical copies; update both together.
The new test 'runs frontend consumer tests when replay-shared source changes' loads `.github/workflows/ci-frontend.yml` with js-yaml, finds the `changes` job step with `id: filter`, and feeds its `with.filters` into `Filter`, asserting `frontend_code` matches. So edits to the `frontend_code` filter in the workflow are checked by these tests; add a similar case when adding paths.
applies: Changes to paths-filter action tests or the frontend_code filter in ci-frontend.yml
says: How do I test changes to the frontend path filter?
The filter tests verify behavior against the actual workflow configuration.
Frontend test filters need to be updated in two separate locations.
Path filter tests load the CI workflow to verify matching works.
Do I edit paths-filter tests in both GitHub and Depot?
search: Mirrored test files for paths-filter action must be updated together. The tests at .github/actions/paths-filter/__tests__/filter.test.ts and .depot/actions/paths-filter/__tests__/filter.test.ts are identical copies; any change to one requires the same change to the other. The test case 'runs frontend consumer tests when replay-shared source changes' loads .github/workflows/ci-frontend.yml, extracts the ci-frontend.yml filter step (id: filter), and validates that the frontend_code filter matches the expected paths. When adding or modifying paths to this filter in the workflow, add corresponding test cases to both test file copies to verify filter behavior.
